skill.summary: Upload videos to Bilibili (哔哩哔哩). Supports automatic login, title, description, tags, and partition selection.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of bilibili-upload skill.
- Upload local video files to Bilibili with configurable title, description, tags, and partition (tid).
- Supports automatic login using biliup with QR code; saves cookies for future uploads.
- Automatically handles Windows UTF-8 encoding issues.
- Provides usage instructions and partition ID table for easy reference.
